digest.component_or_area: Gerrit review-bot authentication and credential rotation
propositions: The compromised GERRIT_BOT_TOKEN was logged in plaintext via query string (?token=) in uvicorn access logs before fix 66af was deployed
Fix 66af (merged to main but not yet deployed to prod) moves token sourcing from URL query parameter to X-Rebar-Token header and adds TokenRedactingFilter to prevent plaintext logging
Token rotation must not occur until 66af code is deployed to production, else the new token will immediately be re-leaked in the same manner

GERRIT_BOT_TOKEN is a shared secret used simultaneously for outbound Gerrit HTTP basic-auth, inbound webhook authentication, and container environment variable, requiring coordinated rotation via service-user.sh to keep all three in sync
